goal: Reference-locked church asset reconstruction with commercial-safe output and zero-cost-first tooling.
production_strategy: Do not trust one-shot generative 3D as final geometry.
Trace front/side silhouettes from the supplied sheets and constrain the authored mesh to that visual hull.
Use sketch/retopo tools for Gothic relief and small features.
Use AI image-to-3D only as a candidate high-poly source; accept it only after silhouette and runtime gates.
Keep PBR/material generation separate from geometry fitting so baked lighting is not copied into albedo.

tools.name: Retopo Draw
tools.role: draw strokes directly on a mesh, generate quad-dominant topology, project result back to source surface

tools.name: GreaseMesh
tools.role: Grease Pencil strokes -> solid/mirror/path/wall meshes; boolean cuts and lattice wrapping

tools.name: Differentiable Mesh Optimizer
tools.role: multi-view silhouette loss using PyTorch3D to optimize mesh vertices against reference masks

tools.name: PyTorch3D
tools.role: differentiable rasterization, camera optimization and mesh deformation primitives

tools.name: TripoSG Scribble
tools.license: MIT model card; dependency licenses must still be audited
tools.role: scribble+prompt to 3D proposal; useful when we literally trace the supplied silhouette

tools.name: Hi3DGen
tools.role: high-fidelity image-to-3D geometry using normal bridging

tools.name: ComfyUI-3D-Pack
tools.role: orchestrates Hunyuan3D, PartCrafter, MV-Adapter, Wonder3D, TRELLIS-style workflows and UV/PBR baking

tools.name: PartCrafter
tools.role: single-image 3D with separated parts; promising for altar carcass/candles/cross decomposition

tools.name: TRELLIS.2
tools.license: Repository README says MIT, but a 2026 GitHub issue reports missing LICENSE file; re-audit before shipping

tools.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1
tools.license: Tencent Hunyuan non-commercial terms surfaced in repository/API metadata
tools.role: strong PBR texturing and image-to-mesh research reference

tools.name: Meshroom / AliceVision
tools.role: true multi-photo photogrammetry; useful when consistent real photographs exist
